scenario.title: The Salt Lantern
scenario.premise: The Salt Lantern is the last warm room before the old salt-mine tunnels swallow the light, and Sella Holt keeps a board of what's owed to whoever goes down and comes back.

salt-lantern.name: The Salt Lantern
salt-lantern.brief: A tavern built over the old mine head
salt-lantern.description: The Salt Lantern sits over the boarded mine head, its floor gritty with tracked-in salt and its lanterns turned low against the damp. A corkboard by the door carries the week's jobs in a dozen hands; Sella Holt works the taps without looking up, and Convoy Thess holds his usual stool at the end of the bar.

sella-holt.name: Sella Holt
sella-holt.brief: Keeps the Salt Lantern and the board; she's buried three husbands and a mine crew, and outlasted all of them.

convoy-thess.name: Convoy Thess
convoy-thess.brief: A one-eyed regular who quit the tunnels years back and now just watches who takes what off the board.

cracked-lantern.name: Cracked Mine Lantern
cracked-lantern.brief: Pulled from the shaft years ago; the glass is starred but it still holds a flame.

player.name: Kael
player.brief: A scarred relic-hunter who comes wherever something old lies sealed, and does not leave it shut.

board.title: The Flooded Chapel
board.pitch: Water's moving in the old chapel shaft where nothing should be moving it. Bring back whatever's stirring it, and half of whatever else you find is yours.

board.title: Pell's Debt
board.pitch: Pell owes the collector three casks of salt he doesn't have. Clear the wormlord out of his cellar tunnel and I'll call the debt settled myself.

board.title: The Whistling Stair
board.pitch: The old well-stair's been whistling at night and nobody's gone down to look. First pick of whatever's down there, plus what the board usually pays.
